newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-BT, MCI cut at Lehman.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-BT, MCI cut at Lehman.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc and its planned merger partner MCI Communications Corp were downgraded by Lehman Brothers, the investment bank said on Thursday.
The two telecom groups were cut to "outperform" from "buy," after having outperformed their respective markets by 19 percent and 34 percent since the merger was announced, Lehman said.
Lehman analysts remain bullish on Concert's long-term prospects but said the immediate upside was limited by competition facing MCI.

Lehman expects the combined group to grow earnings by eight percent a year from 1997 through 2001. However, earnings forecasts for MCI were cut to $1.99 per share from $2.03 for 1998, due to ongoing weakness in consumer long-distance calls and continuing losses in its local exchange business.
